import_share.title: Import an existing HeyLight mesh
import_share.description: Paste the full text decoded from Heylight's Share Device QR code, or upload an image containing that QR code. Use exactly one method.

data_description.qr_text: Paste the JSON text beginning with {"agent":...
data_description.qr_image: PNG/JPEG/WebP photo or screenshot of the QR code.

create_network.title: Create a new HeyLight mesh
create_network.description: Home Assistant will create and own a new Bluetooth Mesh network with random 128-bit network and application keys. Reset a light to pairing mode after setup, then add it from the integration options.

data_description.network_name: A friendly name used only in Home Assistant.

error.missing_input: Paste the QR text or upload a QR image.
error.choose_one: Use either QR text or a QR image, not both.
error.invalid_share: The QR data is not a supported HeyLight Share Device payload: {reason}
error.invalid_qr: The uploaded image could not be decoded as a HeyLight QR code: {reason}

abort.already_configured: This HeyLight mesh is already configured.

progress.title: HeyLight device commissioning
progress.scan_unprovisioned: Scanning for unprovisioned Bluetooth Mesh devices. Keep the new light in pairing/reset mode and close to a Bluetooth adapter.
progress.provision_device: Provisioning the selected device, assigning its Mesh address, installing the network keys, reading Composition Data, and binding the models.
progress.finish_commissioning: Finishing Mesh configuration for the already provisioned device.

menu_options.finish_setup: Finish setup of a provisioned device

select_device.title: Select a device
select_device.description: Choose the unprovisioned Bluetooth Mesh device to add. If none are listed, submit this page to scan again.

device_details.title: Add device to mesh
device_details.description: Give the device a Home Assistant name. For an imported HeyLight network you must also choose an unused unicast address because a Share Device QR code may not contain every node in the original mesh.

data_description.unicast_address: Unused primary element address, for example 0x0010. Home Assistant validates it against nodes known to this integration.

finish_setup.title: Finish device setup
finish_setup.description: Select a device that completed provisioning but did not finish Composition/AppKey/model configuration.

provision_failed.title: Device setup did not complete
provision_failed.description:
Reason: {reason}

If **Finish setup of a provisioned device** is available, try that first. If the device never appears as a Mesh Proxy and you have reset it back to pairing mode, use **Forget interrupted device** before adding it again.

forget_pending.title: Forget interrupted device
forget_pending.description: Use this only after factory-resetting the device back to pairing mode, or when you are certain provisioning did not complete. Deleting the DeviceKey of a device that is actually provisioned makes it unconfigurable from Home Assistant until it is reset.

data.confirm: I confirm the device was reset, or provisioning definitely did not complete

error.no_unprovisioned_devices: No connectable unprovisioned Bluetooth Mesh device was found. Put the light into pairing/reset mode, keep it nearby, then submit to scan again.
error.invalid_unicast_address: Enter an unused unicast address from 0x0001 to 0x7FFE, for example 0x0010.
error.confirm_forget_required: Confirm that the device was reset or that provisioning definitely did not complete before forgetting it.
